text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In recognition of her 
achievements—headlined by her Classic-tier 
victory in the Tenno Sho (Autumn)—Symboli 
Kris S sat down for a special interview.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By steadily accumulating "results," her 
earnest sincerity came to be accepted by 
the public. Her coolness, backed by 
undeniable strength, was also warmly 
received.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, Tap Dance City spoke of her 
"romantic dream." She wants to build a 
giant castle for her friends. To do that, 
she plans to make a name for herself in 
races and earn a fortune.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And for the sake of "romance," she 
declared war, vowing to defeat Symboli 
Kris S at the Takarazuka Kinen. Her fiery 
passion was reminiscent of Tanino Gimlet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S feels she lacks the fiery 
passion those two have. But brushing the 
thought aside, she decides to focus on her 
next goal, the Takarazuka Kinen.
